$description: The combined interface: the look of direction C "studio" (its colours, radii, code font, coloured status bar and IDE-compact rows) on the structure of direction A "classic refined" and its visual inspector controls: design/final/. npm run gen builds src/ui/tokens.css from this file with Style Dictionary; the editor and the mockup read only those custom properties. Dark is a fresh profile's theme (manifest/environment.json); light is the other; "system" follows prefers-color-scheme.

micro.$description: Badges, ruler numbers and file-type tags

caption.$description: Metadata, units, counts, legend, status bar

body.$description: Default UI text: rows, fields, menus

overline.$description: Upper-case section headers of the sidebar

title.$description: Panel titles and the selected element name

code.$description: The code view and file names

control.$description: Height of fields and small buttons

control-lg.$description: Height of top bar buttons and pickers

row.$description: Height of a row in trees and lists

tag-field.$description: Width of the quick panel's Tag field: as wide as the longest tag a person types (blockquote), centred in the panel's bar; a narrower box takes the focus and refuses every character typed into it

breadcrumb-crumb.$description: The longest a breadcrumb crumb grows before its name is cut (spec status-bar)

sidebar.$description: Explorer, Insert and Styles; with the activity bar and the inspector it leaves the canvas 888 px wide at 1440 px, as in direction A

panel-window-width.$description: Width of a floating panel window (spec floating-panels; interactions.json floating.width)

panel-window-height.$description: Tallest a floating panel window opens (spec floating-panels; interactions.json floating.height)

right-dock.$description: Width of the right dock a panel is docked to (spec floating-panels; interactions.json dock.minWidth)

panel-stacked.$description: Smallest height of a panel stacked under another (spec panel-combine-tabs; interactions.json panels.minStackedHeight)

inspector.$description: The inspector's default width (layout.json's inspector-width splitter): 288 px until the user's review of 2026-10-05 (DEC-66), widened by the 16 px the label column took and the 32 px every row's Reset column now keeps, so a pair's halves keep their room

frame-tabs.$description: Breakpoint tabs attached to the top of the canvas frame

code-pane.$description: Width of the code pane in the Split view

drop-line.$description: Thickness of the drop indicator's insertion line (the user's real-use audit, item 3.1: 3 to 4 px)

snap-line.$description: Width of a snap line (item 4.5: the 1 px line of the column grid s colour was too weak to follow).

chip.$description: The track of a segmented control and a chip: 24 px buttons inside a 1 px border (jornada02 GRAMMAR R-03)

header.$description: A section header and a panel header

label-column.$description: The label column of a field row in the inspector and the settings: every value starts at the same x; 116 px since the user's review of 2026-10-05 (DEC-66), so a Portuguese name fits one line, set in a detail and bold when its value is set

label-column-card.$description: The label column inside a card, a dialog or an interaction: the inspector's 116 px since the user's review of 2026-10-05 (LR2; DEC-66), so a name fits one line in both languages

timeline-side.$description: The Timeline's side: the animations and their settings, beside the track; 288 px (236 before) since the user's review of 2026-10-05 (LR2), so its values keep their room beside the cards' 116 px label column

popover.$description: The width of a popover (the colour picker, the add-class prompt)

palette.$description: The width of the command palette

bg-app.$description: Behind every panel: the top bar, the activity bar and the gaps between regions

surface.$description: Panels: sidebar, inspector, dock, status bar

surface-raised.$description: Menus, the palette, popovers, the quick panel

surface-hover.$description: A row or button under the pointer

surface-selected.$description: The selected row, tab or file

canvas.$description: The canvas around the page frame

border-strong.$description: Field outlines, splitter grips, ruler ticks

accent.$description: Primary action, current tab, selection in panels

origin-here.$description: Value set on this target, in this breakpoint and state

origin-breakpoint.$description: Value that comes from another breakpoint

origin-state.$description: Value that comes from another state

origin-here-soft.$description: Field background of a value set here

origin-breakpoint-soft.$description: Field background of a value from another breakpoint

origin-state-soft.$description: Field background of a value from another state

origin-inherited-soft.$description: Field background of an inherited value

canvas-selection.$description: Selection outline, handles and the selection label

canvas-drop.$description: Drop indicator: its own colour, never the selection's (the user's real-use audit, item 3.1)

mode-breakpoint.$description: Frame outline and warning band of a non-base breakpoint

mode-state.$description: The state picker and the selected element label while a state other than base is active

on-mode-text.$description: Text on the text editing colour

tip-bg.$description: Handle hints and the number field on the canvas

canvas-handle.$description: Fill of resize, radius and drop handles, white in both themes as in every design tool

on-canvas-band.$description: Text of spacing band values and measurements

canvas-band-shade.$description: Mixed into a band colour to darken the value chip behind white text

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind the palette and dialogs

status-bar.$description: The status bar's background: the one coloured bar of the window (direction C)

on-status-bar.$description: Text and icons on the status bar, legible at 4.5:1 or more (tools/gen/tokens.ts checks it)

canvas-snap.$description: Snap lines of a moving or resizing element (the user real-use audit, item 4.5): their own colour, never the target s, so the alignment reads apart from the column grid.

z.$description: The layers of the interface, bottom to top: each surface that floats over another takes its layer from here (a z-index of 0 to 9 orders the parts of one component inside its own stacking)

floating-hint.$description: The hint a floating panel shows where it will dock

backdrop.$description: The backdrop an open menu or popover lays under itself: a press on it closes

menu.$description: A menu, a popover, a prompt

menu-anchor.$description: The top bar menu buttons above the backdrop, so hovering another switches menus

drag.$description: What a drag carries under the pointer

preview.$description: The preview that covers the editor

picker.$description: A picker and the shield under it (colour, link, asset)

dialog.$description: A modal dialog and its shield

guard.$description: The bar that says another tab is editing: above everything
